0022600206.text: The Grizzlies (6-2, 4-0 on the road, on a two-game losing streak) are 3rd in the Southwest, 0.5 games back, while the Raptors (4-4, on a one-game losing streak) are 4th in the Atlantic, 3.5 games back, in this 10th game of the season for Memphis. Memphis is missing Isaiah Stewart (knee bruise) and Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness), and Toronto is without Immanuel Quickley (hamstring), Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation), Nate Bittle (foot fracture) and Scottie Barnes (groin soreness). The teams have not yet met in the 2026-27 season, but the Grizzlies lost 0-2 in the 2025-26 season, most recently 128-96 in Memphis on April 3, 2026.
